in_marathi.name: Rohinidev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The one who is like the sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohinidev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rohinidev is a unisex name of Sanskrit origin. It is derived from Rohini, the name of the full moon, and Dev, meaning 'god' or 'divine'. Rohinidev thus means 'the one who is like the sun'.
